Best dim sum in Ho Chi Minh City
Sep 2026 • Couples
Best dim sum in Ho Chi Minh city!!!
We came here because we fancied some Dim Sum and boy did they deliver. We took advantage of the All you can eat offer and when bombarded by the sheer bounty of choice we were deftly guided by Thuy our waitress, who among our choices suggested some excellent items we would have missed. The siu mai in particular was utterly divine: meaty, satisfying and absolutely delicious. Other must eats include the mustard and mayo prawns, the beef in black pepper sauce, and the charcoal prawn and chive dim sum.
You MUST visit this place. Exceptional value and fantastic quality. I would absolutely eat here again.

I was in the mood for dim sum and decided to try this place. Yep, it was the best meal I had in Saigon. The dim sum was the best I've ever had and I've had it many times in Hong Kong and other cities. The dumpling wrappers were light and tender, the fillings flavorful and cooked to perfection, and the condiments complimented the dim sum perfectly. I had three different ones, recommended by Dat, my server, and they were a good assortment. Still had a bit more room, so I decided to order something from the main menu. Dat suggested the fried shrimp with mustard sauce because most of his customers really liked it. Me? I loved it. Very lightly breaded, cooked just until done, and covered with a spicy, but subtle mustard sauce. It was heaven. They had East West Brewery's Far East IPA on tap which rounded out the lunch. Huy, the dining room manager stopped by the table a couple of times to check up on me which I appreciated. The chef even made a walk through the dining room. I will go back.

Diverse and authentic menu: Kabin offers a diverse menu of authentic Chinese dishes. The selection includes popular classics as well as unique specialties. Every dish we ordered showcased authentic flavors and ingredients, true to the essence of Chinese cuisine. The inclusion of vegetarian and gluten-free options caters to a variety of dietary preferences, ensuring there are plenty of options for all guests. Taste and presentation: The food at Kabin is delightful, with each dish bursting with flavor. The presentation is visually appealing, demonstrating attention to detail and culinary artistry. From savory soups to perfectly seasoned stir-fries, every bite is a testament to the chef's skill. Portion sizes are generous, allowing for sharing and ensuring a satisfying dining experience. Cleanliness and hygiene: Kabin maintained good cleanliness standards throughout our visit. Dining areas, utensils and restrooms are clean and well maintained, demonstrating a commitment to hygiene. We felt comfortable and assured about hygiene and cleanliness during our time at the restaurant. Value for money: Considering the quality of food, service and overall experience, Kabin offers good value for money. Although prices may be a little higher than regular Chinese restaurants, the outstanding flavors, presentation and attentive service make it worth the cost. Recommended!
Sep 2015 • Friends
After a wonderful 15 day organised tour of Vietnam, I took my New Zealand born Chinese mother and New York City based sister to this restaurant for dinner to change things up.

Kabin resides in the 5* Renaissance Riverside Hotel so you can expect their dishes to be priced accordingly and, of course, accessible by staircase or lift.

Kabin has a reasonably attractive dining room and has two private dining areas for larger groups. The wait staff are friendly and professional although there is a tendency for your dishes to be removed a tad too promptly.

The food is very good. We ordered a half order of Peking Duck (550,000d) which includes a choice of 1 of 4 accompanying dishes - we choose the very good minced duck and lettuce leaves. The Peking Duck comes pre assembled and we received 12 long pancakes with a bowl containing lashings of Hoisen Sauce.

We also ordered the Braised Pork with Eggplant and Salted Fish. A tremendous dish with just the right amount of chilli. The Seasonal Vegetables were well cooked and the ingredients wonderfully varied. 

If you're up to blowing your travel budget or are fortunate enough to have a spare 1,300,000d (US$65), have a craving for some delicious Chinese food then Kabin is recommended to you.
